verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk-operation capability, such as bulk edit, delete, update or import across many items. Task suites group tasks so the same tests can run against every agent version, but that is batch evaluation, an adjacent feature, not bulk operations on items. Multi-language SDK automation is a developer building block, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
